a11y.title: Accessibility statement
a11y.intro: This concept website is designed to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA, in English and Arabic.
a11y.h.how: How we make this site accessible
a11y.how.1: Every page works with a keyboard alone, with a visible focus indicator.
a11y.how.2: Search follows the ARIA combobox pattern and announces result counts to screen readers.
a11y.how.3: Text meets AA colour contrast; motion is reduced when you ask your device to, and the background video can always be paused.
a11y.how.4: Pages work without JavaScript, including the full search results page.
a11y.how.5: Arabic pages are right-to-left throughout, with Arabic typography and Western digits.
a11y.known.1: Sample content and placeholder values ([TBC]) are used throughout this concept.
a11y.known.2: Third-party catalogue and database platforms will need separate assessment.
a11y.contact: If something doesn't work for you, contact the accessibility team: [TBC]. We aim to reply within [TBC] working days.
a11y.status: Last tested: [TBC]. Method: automated checks (axe-core) and manual keyboard and screen reader testing.
